title: Living with the popups
target: How to deal with the popups in Supermarket Simulator, given that some of them take over input and some of them are questions you have to answer.
version: 1.6.0 (223), read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A moment to read rather than click

steps.do: Expect a popup to take over input rather than treating it as decoration.
steps.because: popups take focus through a handler of their own (PopupFocusHandler)

steps.do: Read which kind of popup it is before reacting.
steps.because: the game sorts popups into types (PopupType)

steps.do: Answer a question deliberately rather than clicking through it.
steps.because: there is a question popup of its own (QuestionPopup)

steps.do: Use the information popups when you are unsure how a system works.
steps.because: they are assembled from their own elements and content (InfoPopupElement)

steps.do: Do not assume every popup appears the instant something happens.
steps.because: the manager can raise one after a delay (PopUpManager)

commonMistakes: Clicking through a question without reading it.
Carrying on as though a popup were scenery.
Ignoring the information panels when learning a system.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
